simple.meaning: אֲבַעְבֻּעָה (ʼăbaʻbuʻâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “an inflammatory pustule (as eruption).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 9:9. The surrounding context includes kingship, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֲבַעְבֻּעָה (H76) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: אֲבַעְבֻּעָה (ʼăbaʻbuʻâh) / H76 is traced through Exodus 9:9, Exodus 9:10 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H76. ababuah אֲבַעְבֻּעֹת noun feminine plural blisters, boils ( אֲבַעְבּוּעְיָן ᵑ7 ; compare בֶּעְבַּע ᵑ7 , Late Hebrew בּוּעָה בַּעְבּוּעַ , Syriac ) Exod 9:9 אֲבַעְבֻּעֹת מֹּרֵחַ שְׁחִין , compare 9:10 . בוץ so Thes, better ביץ (compare Arabic surpass in whiteness ; whiteness ).
definitions.rootNote: (by reduplication) from an unused root (meaning to belch forth);

occurrences.englishText: It shall become small dust over all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal, throughout all the land of Egypt.”
They took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward the sky; and it became boils and blisters breaking on man and on animal.
